lado_card.t: The 6 courses of the Cinema with AI program
lado_card.texto: This is the last one. From direction to the site: go back to any course through the INEMA Videos area.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · Cinema with AI program, course 5 of 6 · eventos.inema.pro/videos · inema.club

inicio.kicker: Cinema with AI program · course 5 of 6 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Cinematic websites: the video becomes a page, and the page opens fast
inicio.lead: A clip becomes frames, scroll picks the frame, and the page feels like a film. Here you build that with an agent, measure the weight, add depth with Three.js, make the brand film from the site, chain clips with no cuts, and check it on your phone and with reduced motion. All local, no credits.
inicio.capa_alt: A dark editing desk with one monitor showing code, another with a web page open on a misty landscape, and a phone standing up showing the same page.
inicio.aulas_sub: A fictional product page, the Aurora 35 lens, runs through the course. The kit includes the page, the check scripts, and rehearsal clips made with ffmpeg: no video generator is needed.

itens: People who build sites with Claude Code or Codex and use the terminal.
People who already have a clip (or are about to generate one) and want it to become the opening of a page.
People who took course 3 (motion by code) and want to bring the motion into the browser.

blocos.t: What you walk away able to do
itens: Turn a clip into frames and tie the frames to scroll.
Measure the weight per visitor and decide whether the page deserves the film.
Add depth with Three.js without drawing for nothing.
Check the phone and reduced motion before publishing.
1 · Generation: image and video with AI
3 · Motion by code with an agent
